title: Discover playable building blocks
note: The catalog starts with capabilities and curated demos. No sign-in is needed to explore.

title: Search by intent and taxonomy
note: Project and component results share a search surface. Explain why a match appeared and show reuse readiness.

title: Take a tour of a real project
note: The playable experience sits beside a decomposition into useful capabilities. The real demo opens externally.

title: Inspect a reusable capability
note: Show extraction scope, compatibility and source evidence before offering the handoff.

title: Use in my game
note: The plugin is the primary workflow. A portable agent brief remains available; hosted repository execution is a later phase.

title: Review a connected integration
note: Later-phase concept: show changes, actual validation evidence and a reviewable patch before acceptance.

title: Submit and onboard a developer
note: A demo and repository are enough to begin. Licensing and extraction review happen before publication.

title: Preserve optional remix provenance
note: Later-phase graph tracks composition and forks. Source notices are required where applicable; public sharing is optional.

title: Install the preloaded skills plugin
note: The core MVP includes six skills and a read-only catalog connection. This deliverable contains a skills starter; the live connector still needs implementation.
